post.description: Requests cancellation of response `{id}`. Acts on durable state, so it works for background runs that outlive the client connection. Cancellation is asynchronous: a `200` acknowledges the request (`status: cancelling`) and the run stops shortly after - poll `GET /v1/agent/{id}` for its terminal status. Cancelling a run that is already terminal returns `400`. Ownership is enforced server side; a cross-tenant or unknown id surfaces as `404`.

get.description: Returns your organization's Perplexity usage analytics as a bucketed time series for a single dataset. Requires an organization analytics API key, generated by an org admin from Settings → Organization → Computer in the Perplexity web app. Only complete UTC grid buckets are returned: start_time snaps down to its bucket, and the in-progress bucket is never included. Datasets differ in what they count: credits for credit_usage, queries for query_volume, distinct active members for daily_active_users, and thread counts for the rest. Buckets of daily_active_users are not additive — a member active on several days is counted once per day, so summing them is not the window's active-member count.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: The dataset to query. query_volume and daily_active_users are daily organization-level datasets: they reject bucket_width=1h and user_email.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Window start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive. Snapped down to the bucket grid, so the first bucket can include usage from before this time.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Window end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive. Defaults to now; future values are capped at now. The window may span at most 90 days.

parameters.name: bucket_width
parameters.description: Bucket size. Buckets align to the UTC grid. Not accepted as 1h for query_volume or daily_active_users, which are stored at day grain.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Buckets per page. 1d: default 7, max 31. 1h: default 24, max 168.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_page. Valid only with the same query parameters it was issued for.

parameters.name: user_email
parameters.description: Restrict results to a single member of your organization. Emails that don't match a current member return a generic 400. Not available for query_volume or daily_active_users, which are aggregated per organization; use the v2 endpoint for per-member query volume.

200.description: Bucketed usage for the requested window. Buckets without data carry count 0; the analytics store syncs periodically, so a zero in a recent bucket can mean the data hasn't synced yet.

400.description: Invalid parameters (type: bad_request) or semantically invalid request (type: invalid_request) — e.g. start_time after end_time, a window over 90 days, a misused pagination cursor, or a user_email that doesn't match a member of the organization.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (type: unauthorized).

404.description: The Analytics API is not enabled for this organization (type: feature_disabled).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (type: request_rate_limit_exceeded). Limits apply per organization across all of its keys.

get.description: Returns your organization's Perplexity usage broken down per member, as daily buckets. Each day lists one row per member with usage that day, keyed by email. credit_usage carries the same Model and Credit Source breakdown as v1; query_volume carries Feature, Project and Comet. Uses the same organization analytics API key as v1. Only complete UTC days are returned; the in-progress day is never included.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: The dataset to query. query_volume at this grain carries Feature, Project and Comet breakdowns, but not Model or Model Family.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: The dimension to group each day's usage by. user_email is currently the only supported value.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Window start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive. Snapped down to the day grid, so the first day can include usage from before this time.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Window end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive. Defaults to now; future values are capped at now. The window may span at most 90 days.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Member rows per page. Default 50, max 100. A page can span multiple days.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_page. Valid only with the same query parameters it was issued for.

200.description: Per-member daily usage for the requested window. Days with no attributable usage are omitted; the analytics store syncs periodically, so recent days may not yet be present.

400.description: Invalid parameters (type: bad_request) — e.g. a dataset or group_by outside the accepted values — or a semantically invalid request (type: invalid_request), e.g. start_time after end_time, a window over 90 days, or a misused pagination cursor.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (type: unauthorized).

404.description: The Analytics API is not enabled for this organization (type: feature_disabled).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (type: request_rate_limit_exceeded). Limits apply per organization across all of its keys.

Creates a skill from a zip bundle. The bundle must contain a `SKILL.md`
that provides the skill name and description; those fields are read from
the bundle, not from the request.

put.description:
Uploads a new zip bundle as a new revision of an existing skill. Pass the
revision you expect to replace as the required `expected_revision`; the
request fails with `409` if the skill has already moved past it, so the
update cannot race a concurrent write. Name and description are re-read
from the new bundle.

429.description: Rate limit or upload concurrency limit exceeded

delete.description:
Deletes a skill. Pass the current revision as `expected_revision`; the
delete fails with `409` if the skill has a newer revision, so a delete
never races a concurrent update.

409.description: Revision conflict; the skill moved past expected_revision

get.description: Lists the revisions of a skill, newest first.

Returns a short-lived URL to download the skill bundle as a zip. Without
`revision`, returns the active revision.

- `response.reasoning.search_results`: Search results received
- `response.reasoning.fetch_url_queries`: URL fetch queries issued
- `response.reasoning.fetch_url_results`: URL fetch results received

Model.description: Represents a model available through the Agent API.

id.description: The model identifier in `provider/model-name` format. Use this value as the `model` parameter in Agent API requests.

object.description: The object type, which is always `model`.

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the model was created.

owned_by.description: The provider that owns the model (e.g. `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `perplexity`, `xai`, `z-ai`, `moonshotai`, `nvidia`).

ListModelsResponse.description: Response from the List Models endpoint. Contains a list of available models.

object.description: The object type, which is always `list`.

ComputerUsageCategoryCount.description: A bucket's count for one value of a category breakdown — e.g. a connector name for connectors, a duration band for task_durations, or paid/promo for credit_usage's Credit Source axis.

start_time.description: Bucket start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive.

end_time.description: Bucket end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive.

count.description: Bucket total. For credit_usage this may exceed the sum of any single breakdown — usage without a category attribution counts toward the total but not the breakdown.

by_categories.description: Category breakdowns for this bucket, keyed by the labels declared in the response's top-level `categories` list. An empty list means the bucket has no data for that breakdown.

categories.description: Category breakdown labels the requested dataset surfaces, in canonical render order. Each label is a key in every bucket's `by_categories`.

data.description: Every bucket in the page's window, in chronological order. Buckets without data carry count 0 and an empty breakdown.

has_more.description: Whether more buckets exist beyond this page. False also when the window's remaining buckets are past the current data frontier.

next_page.description: Cursor for the next page; pass as the page parameter with otherwise identical query parameters.

ComputerUsageV2Result.description: One member's credit usage for a single day.

user_email.description: The member's email. Rows whose member can no longer be resolved to an email are omitted.

count.description: The member's credit total for the day. May exceed the sum of any single breakdown — usage without a category attribution counts toward the total but not the breakdown.

by_categories.description: The member's day broken down by each label in the response's top-level `categories` list.

start_time.description: Day start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive.

end_time.description: Day end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive.

results.description: One row per member with credit usage on this day.

categories.description: Category breakdown labels each member row surfaces, in canonical render order. Each label is a key in every row's `by_categories`.

data.description: Daily buckets in chronological order, each with one row per member who used credits that day. Days with no attributable usage are omitted.

has_more.description: Whether more member rows exist beyond this page.

next_page.description: Cursor for the next page; pass as the page parameter with otherwise identical query parameters.

McpTool.description: Connects a user-supplied remote MCP server. Agent API discovers the server's tools when the request starts and calls them like native tools. Matches OpenAI's mcp tool. `defer_loading: true` keeps discovered definitions out of the initial model context and lets the model search, inspect, and call them as needed. `require_approval` and `connector_id` are ignored: every call auto-runs, and only bring-your-own `server_url` is honored.

server_label.description: Unique per request, ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$. Namespaces the server's tools.

server_url.description: HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server. Must be a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint; the legacy SSE transport is not supported.

authorization.description: An access token passed to the remote MCP server for authentication. Provide the raw token value. Never logged or echoed.

allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist of tool names. Empty exposes all discovered tools.

defer_loading.description: When true, keeps discovered tool definitions out of the initial model context and lets the model load relevant schemas as needed. Defaults to false.
